name: 50-teakettler
description: Teakettler: a small brown dog-like Northwoods critter with big pointed upright ears, pink inner ears, a stubby curled tail and thin legs, steam puffing from its nose. Flat black-outline pixel art.

idle.action: Standing in place, it raises its head and whistles like a boiling kettle, a small white puff of steam blowing from its nose, then lowers its head again. Same facing, same size, feet planted. Black one-pixel outlines, flat fills.

walk.action: Walking backwards in place, trotting tail-first: it keeps facing the same way while its four thin legs step back toward its tail, one diagonal pair then the other. Same facing, same size, ground line. Black one-pixel outlines, flat fills.
